```{r}
if (is.null(params$run_dir)) {
    stop("params$run_dir is required")
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(data.table)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(knitr)
    library(cowplot)
})

helper_path = normalizePath(
    file.path(
        dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)),
        "..",
        "..",
        "helpers",
        "spatial_helper_visium.R"
    ),
    mustWork = TRUE
)
source(helper_path)

run_dir = normalizePath(params$run_dir)
spe = readRDS(file.path(run_dir, "visium_banksy_output.rds"))
qc_summary = fread(file.path(run_dir, "visium_banksy_qc_summary.tsv"))
section_summary = fread(file.path(run_dir, "visium_banksy_section_summary.tsv"))
run_summary = fread(file.path(run_dir, "visium_banksy_run_summary.tsv"))

preferred_cluster_col = if (
    "marker_cluster_column" %in% colnames(run_summary) &&
    nrow(run_summary) > 0 &&
    !is.na(run_summary$marker_cluster_column[[1]]) &&
    nzchar(run_summary$marker_cluster_column[[1]])
) {
    run_summary$marker_cluster_column[[1]]
} else {
    NULL
}

sample_order = visium_sample_order(spe)
lambda0_cluster = resolve_visium_cluster_column(spe, lambda = 0)
lambda02_cluster = resolve_visium_cluster_column(
    spe,
    lambda = 0.2,
    preferred_col = preferred_cluster_col
)
sample_palette = build_visium_palette(sample_order)
lambda0_palette = build_visium_palette(colData(spe)[[lambda0_cluster]])
lambda02_palette = build_visium_palette(colData(spe)[[lambda02_cluster]])

qc_long = melt(
    qc_summary,
    id.vars = c("source_file", "sample_id"),
    measure.vars = c(
        "n_spots_input",
        "n_spots_hard_filter",
        "n_spots_nonzero",
        "n_spots_qc_keep"
    ),
    variable.name = "stage",
    value.name = "n_spots"
)
qc_long[, sample_id := factor(as.character(sample_id), levels = sample_order)]
composition = visium_cluster_composition_dt(
    spe,
    lambda02_cluster,
    sample_order = sample_order
)
```

# Run Summary

```{r}
kable(run_summary)
```

# Spot Retention

```{r}
ggplot(qc_long, aes(sample_id, n_spots, fill = stage)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
        title = "Spot retention by sample",
        x = "Sample",
        y = "Spots"
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

# Section Summary

```{r}
kable(head(section_summary[order(n_spots)], 20))
```

# UMAPs

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 16
cowplot::plot_grid(
    plot_visium_umap(
        spe,
        "UMAP_Harmony_BANKSY_lam0",
        "visium_sample_id",
        "UMAP: lambda 0, colored by sample",
        palette = sample_palette
    ),
    plot_visium_umap(
        spe,
        "UMAP_Harmony_BANKSY_lam0",
        lambda0_cluster,
        "UMAP: lambda 0, colored by cluster",
        palette = lambda0_palette
    ),
    ncol = 2
)
```

```{r}

)
```

# Cluster Composition by Sample

```{r}
ggplot(composition, aes(sample_id, fraction, fill = cluster)) +
    geom_col(position = "fill") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = lambda02_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
        title = "Cluster composition by sample (lambda 0.2)",
        x = "Sample",
        y = "Fraction"
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
